fluxxy_pvp.setting.low_fire.tooltip: Draw the burning overlay lower on the screen, so it hides less of the view.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.fire_height.tooltip: How far down the fire goes when Low fire is on.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.food_info.tooltip: AppleSkin's saturation outlines over the hunger bar, and its exhaustion bar under it: how close the next hunger point is to going.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.elytra_pitch.tooltip: While gliding, show the angle you look at under the crosshair: positive looking up, negative looking down.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.armor_hud.tooltip: Show the armour you wear, with its durability, in slots left of the hotbar: a slot only for a piece worn. They are only drawn: nothing can be clicked there.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.item_counters.tooltip: Show how many golden apples, ender pearls, totems, arrows, potions and cobwebs you carry, bottom right.
fluxxy_pvp.setting.damage_indicator.tool: Show how many hearts a hit took, above your hearts, for a moment.
